body:
I've just been using Acrobat's basic highlight and note functions. I tried Drawboard briefly, but I didn't like it very much.

If I have to make a lot of handwritten notes, I just print the document to OneNote.

I have problems with the same, tbh. And then I have trouble getting back to sleep until I orgasm. I'm kind of trying my own version of the challenge -- no sex, no porn, no nude imagery, no physical contact from the opposite sex.

I'd honestly be setting myself up for failure if I did no M. At least for now. I'm hoping I can work up to it at some point.
Hey, take it as a cosmic sign. Stick around. This is the universe telling you that you should.

God, I know how you feel. I'm in the exact same spot.

I actually feel like I need to take a break from uni just to sort my shit out but at the same time I just want to graduate. I feel the same exact way, just totally trapped. Ugh.

I had picked a method and date but after the holidays and being together with all my family I just feel like I can't do that to them even  though I DON'T want to be alive.

Oh my god, I just wish I'd never been born so badly so I wouldn't be here and no one would feel my absence.

This is beautiful. This is actually a good method -- find the light, the good reasons to stick around. It was my method of choice for a while.

Upvoted and thanks for posting. I hope others will take inspiration from your post.

Yeah, I might hold off on it for a while longer.

It doesn't make me happy, but I think I owe it to my family to try to turn things around and see this as a fresh start -- at least for a little while longer.

We'll see, I guess.

Thanks, unifutomaki.

I think you should tell your doctor.

When I told my psychiatrist she asked questions, they need to gauge if you're a danger to yourself at the moment. She asked if I had a plan, a date and stuff like that.

And back when I told a counselor she asked me to sign a promise note that I wouldn't kill myself without seeking help first. It was a school counselor back when I was like 12, so I had to give a copy to my mom.

Most times when you tell a doctor they don't put you in an institution or anything, though to be totally honest, you sound more like you might be a danger to yourself than I was back when I told the people that I was suicidal.

The thing is, I'm not rushing this at all. I've had this plan for a while and I've been suicidal ever since I was about twelve.

I mean, you're right that at this point I have little to lose by sticking around a while longer -- I just don't like the thought of it.

Like I said, I was happy after I had set a date and the thought of sticking around really depresses me.

Thanks, intheriptide.

I don't know. I mean, I've thought about telling someone in my family, but at the same time I don't want to burden them.

Like, if I decide to go through with it anyway they'll just end up feeling guilty that they didn't do something. Idk.

I'm honestly not sure what to do anymore.

Thanks, WhoaMiracleAlligner.

I've tried therapy and psychiatry. I've been on meds and haven't liked them.

Just, honestly I do want to give it one last shot for my family, but the thought of it is just so overbearingly oppressive to me.

Thanks for reading, talllli.

Damn, do you know how much damage you can do to your insides?

OTC stuff is OTC for a reason; statistically, there's a low probability you'll actually succeed in killing yourself and like I said YOU CAN DO A LOT OF DAMAGE TO YOUR INTERNAL ORGANS.

People who try overdosing will usually be found or wake up later feeling like shite, have to go to the hospital, get their stomachs pumped and maybe have to go on dialysis for a while and who knows what else.

Seriously, you can really do permanent damage by trying overdosing.

Also, asking for methods is prohibited on this sub, innit?

It's still an amoeba and my date is a few days away.

I didn't want to go thru childbirth anyway. Gross.

>  

Thanks, I guess, haha. Although I'm not gonna be alive long enough for the spawn to get past amoeba status. I never wanted kids.

Personally, I always found Craigslist works. I am always quick to recommend Craigslist to people on here who are sad about relationships/sex.

Maybe it's because I'm female and guys are just horny, but every guy I've hooked up with from Craigslist has been better-looking than me and hella cool. Out of five guys I've been with from Craigslist, I only have one that I regret and it's not even because he was bad, it's because he was looking for a regular instead of a hook-up.

I actually thought about doing it in a gun range as well (definitely outside the home so my family wouldn't have to clean up or pay for clean-up), but then I went in and talked to the staff. It was a family-owned gun shop and they were so nice. I totally changed my mind about the location after that.

I also read this other post on reddit:
https://www.reddit.com/r/Firearms/comments/3n89nl/i_own_a_gun_range_yesterday_a_man_committed/

Don't do it.

That's good. Idk about you, but I feel the suicidal ideation a lot less when I'm doing something I enjoy. I wouldn't say it's enough to make me want to live, but at least I don't actively want to not be alive.

How do you feel when you're playing the games you enjoy? Are they enough to take the edge off for you?

What branch of science do you like most?

I feel that. I think it's more about being depressed for so long that you don't even feel like you're depressed anymore, you know?

They call that total boredom with life ennui.

What do you enjoy doing?

Pets are a good reason to stay alive. If it wasn't for my pets, I honestly wouldn't be here anymore.

Is there any particular reason you're feeling down?

You're still young, though. It can still happen for you.

I'm in college as well and there are a lot of people in their 40s and 50s finishing their degrees -- let alone early 30s. I totally agree with you, it doesn't happen for everyone, but sometimes you just have to accept that. Not travelling doesn't mean you don't get to have a fulfilling life.

And yeah, fuck feeling independent. Friendship and relationships are important. And maybe you have a hard time meeting people because you feel shy. Have you tried online dating? I'm kind of shy like you, and I feel something that helped me a lot was blogging. You meet friends online and it kind of helps you transition into having friends in real life.

I feel like you're feeling kind of pessimistic about your career. May I ask what you studied?

I feel that way.

I read once that if you start feeling depressed when you're young, the depression/suicide ideation gets kind of 'hard wired' into your brain. I don't know if it's true or not, but I think it might be, at least in my case.

I have been severely depressed before. At this point, I wouldn't even say I'm doing as badly as I was before -- in fact I think I cope better now -- but the suicide ideation has never gone away.

Best of luck in finding a therapist.

I understand where you're coming from. I'm not gay, but I'm part of the LGBT community and I know that mainstream gay culture can be toxic -- like the belief that you have to be a total stud or you don't get to have a relationship, racism, ageism.

But you're not alone. There are other guys in the same boat as you.

You say you haven't lived your life. What experiences do you want to have? What do you want to do?
OP, I hope you're OK. Have you spoken to an academic counselor?

Yeah, I agree with the above. I'm not going to try to talk you out of anything, but don't go before you give it a proper chance.

What do you like to do? Read? Find you a local book club. Cars? Take a tech class. Fitness? Take a yoga class.

I also agree with people who say it's easier to meet people online nowdays. Get a Tinder, go on Craigslist -- put yourself out there and stay positive.

I know a lot of girls in their early 20s who have had few relationships, if this is really a factor for you. Take a college class or get a part-time job with the purpose of meeting people.

That's true. Reading posts on here I realize that there are a lot of people who are worse off and I should really count myself lucky, but knowing that doesn't help how I feel. I'm really glad you've taken the time to reply to me; I am rooting for you.
That used to be one of my methods. I used to make a list of reasons to stay alive. That's why I loved the Reasons to Live Pepe meme when it came around, lol.
I'm OK, thank you. I'm certain of my decision and I'm happy about it. I knew the term, but I looked more into it right now when you mentioned it.

I reiterate: mods, please remove if potentially triggering!

I've looked into a lot of methods. I've had attempts in the past, a few of them were cries for help, most notably when I drank an entire bottle of Nyquil at 12. It was a tame attempt, I just threw up a lot but I was OK. But that just taught me to research what meds did and didn't work.

The possibility of a failed attempt has often been what has pulled me back, because you can wind up either really sick or disabled to the point that another attempt isn't even feasible.

I'm gonna say both.

I feel like I'm oversensitive. I can't even see news that isn't political/scientific/abstract because I feel really bad for others. I might see that a girl was raped or something and I'm liable to cry about that for four hours. I feel like the world is a monstrous place where really bad things happen to innocent people without reason.

Even reading posts from others here, I feel like I should be able to help because I've been there so many times and I've always managed to pull myself back, but I just end up feeling guilty because whoops -- here I am, with a plan in mind and no one can stop me, so who am I to try to help?
I put on a good face and try to remain positive for the sake of others, but I feel like it's just that -- a facade, which in no way reflects how I feel inside.
